svg.aria-label: Muscles of facial expression — 表情肌

text.aria-label: Muscles of facial expression — 表情肌
Anterior view — 前面观
Frontal belly of occipitofrontalis — 枕额肌额腹
Orbicularis oculi, orbital part — 眼轮匝肌眶部
Orbicularis oculi, palpebral part — 眼轮匝肌睑部
Zygomaticus major — 颧大肌
Buccinator — 颊肌
Platysma — 颈阔肌
Modiolus — 蜗轴
Orbicularis oris — 口轮匝肌
Right lateral view — 右侧面观
Epicranial aponeurosis — 帽状腱膜
Occipital belly of occipitofrontalis — 枕额肌枕腹
Frontal belly — 额腹
Platysma — 颈阔肌
Buccinator — 颊肌
Orbicularis oris — 口轮匝肌
Origin area — 起点区
Insertion area — 止点区
Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Occipitofrontalis — 枕额肌
Origin: skin of the eyebrow (frontal belly); superior nuchal line (occipital belly) — 起点：眉部皮肤（额腹）；上项线（枕腹）
text.tspan: Origin: skin of the eyebrow (frontal belly); superior nuchal line (occipital belly)
起点：眉部皮肤（额腹）；上项线（枕腹）

text.aria-label: Insertion: epicranial aponeurosis — 止点：帽状腱膜
Orbicularis oculi — 眼轮匝肌
Origin: medial orbital margin and medial palpebral ligament — 起点：眶内侧缘和睑内侧韧带
text.tspan: Origin: medial orbital margin and medial palpebral ligament
起点：眶内侧缘和睑内侧韧带

text.aria-label: Insertion: skin around the orbit and the eyelids — 止点：眶周皮肤和眼睑
text.tspan: Insertion: skin around the orbit and the eyelids

text.aria-label: Zygomaticus major — 颧大肌
Origin: lateral surface of the zygomatic bone — 起点：颧骨外侧面
text.tspan: Origin: lateral surface of the zygomatic bone

text.aria-label: Insertion: angle of the mouth (modiolus) — 止点：口角（蜗轴）
Orbicularis oris — 口轮匝肌
Origin: modiolus and the surrounding muscles — 起点：蜗轴和周围的肌
text.tspan: Origin: modiolus and the surrounding muscles

text.aria-label: Insertion: skin and mucous membrane of the lips — 止点：唇的皮肤和黏膜
text.tspan: Insertion: skin and mucous membrane of the lips

text.aria-label: Buccinator — 颊肌
Origin: alveolar processes opposite the molar teeth and the pterygomandibular raphe — 起点：磨牙对应处的牙槽突和翼突下颌缝
text.tspan: Origin: alveolar processes opposite the molar teeth and the pterygomandibular raphe
起点：磨牙对应处的牙槽突和翼突下颌缝

text.aria-label: Insertion: modiolus, continuing into orbicularis oris — 止点：口角的蜗轴，延续为口轮匝肌
text.tspan: Insertion: modiolus, continuing into orbicularis oris
止点：口角的蜗轴，延续为口轮匝肌

text.aria-label: Platysma — 颈阔肌
Origin: skin and fascia over the upper chest and shoulder — 起点：胸上部和肩部表面的皮肤和筋膜
text.tspan: Origin: skin and fascia over the upper chest and shoulder
起点：胸上部和肩部表面的皮肤和筋膜

text.aria-label: Insertion: lower border of the mandible and skin of the lower face — 止点：下颌骨下缘和面下部皮肤
text.tspan: Insertion: lower border of the mandible and skin of the lower face
止点：下颌骨下缘和面下部皮肤

text.aria-label: Most of these muscles attach to skin, so origin and insertion areas are marked only where a bony or tendinous attachment can be shown. — 这些肌大多附着于皮肤，所以只在能画出骨性或腱性附着的地方标出起止点区。
text.tspan: Most of these muscles attach to skin, so origin and insertion areas are marked only where a bony or tendinous attachment can be shown.
这些肌大多附着于皮肤，所以只在能画出骨性或腱性附着的地方标出起止点区。

text.aria-label: The lower attachment of platysma on the chest lies below the picture. — 颈阔肌在胸部的下方附着点在画面之外。
text.tspan: The lower attachment of platysma on the chest lies below the picture.
颈阔肌在胸部的下方附着点在画面之外。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
